make_article.name: harbour-a.txt
make_article.raw:
Source: Coastal Post
Event: H1
Title: Harbour bridge closes

The harbour bridge will close for repairs from Monday, the port authority said. Dr. Meera Iyer, the chief engineer, said the steel cables had corroded faster than expected. Repairs are expected to cost Rs. 310 crore and take about eight months. “We cannot risk another monsoon on these cables,” Iyer told reporters. Ferry services will be doubled while the bridge is shut.

out.title: Harbour bridge closes

Repairs are expected to cost Rs. 310 crore and take about eight months.
“We cannot risk another monsoon on these cables,” Iyer told reporters.
Ferry services will be doubled while the bridge is shut.
